items.item_text: Bachelor of Science degree in biological or equivalent or related fields
Mouse handling and some experience with basic behavioral tasks

The Lab Asst. II will be conducting behavioral training experiments, brain sectioning and histology, and brain imaging data collection with mice. S/he will be responsible for data collection, for scheduling undergraduate students to run the same experiments, and to perform general laboratory duties, including the generating of spreadsheet data summaries in Excel. S/he will also be required to take part in lab and center meetings each week. A Bachelor of Science degree in biological or equivalent or related fields is required. Experience handling mice is required.
Flexibility in working hours when needed

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Good PC Skills, with ideally some knowledge of python, R or Matlab
Strong organizational skills and flexibility in responding to changing priorities
Excellent verbal and written English skills
Ability to work independently after training and some continued supervision.
Excellent interpersonal skills to deal with and sustain cooperative working relationships with undergraduate students and lab scientists
Ability to learn rapidly and follow through tasks with details
